title: SOC Automation — Manual Operasional Lengkap
text: SOC Automation — Manual Operasional Lengkap Bahasa utama: Indonesia · Versi dokumentasi: 5.27.0 · Baseline implementasi: runtime 5.26.1 dan Manager/TUI 1.26.1. Dokumentasi ini adalah sumber rujukan utama untuk keseluruhan SOC Automation: pemasangan awal, konfigurasi, TUI, Jira, SIEM, privacy, Local AI, Gemini, Telegram, Auto FP, worker blue/green, viewer, audit, maintenance, update, rollback, troubleshooting, pengujian, dan riwayat versi. Jalur belajar 1. Baca Gambaran Sistem dan Arsitektur . 2. Ikuti Instalasi Automation untuk pemasangan awal. 3. Lengkapi Konfigurasi dan jalankan Preflight & Readiness . 4. Gunakan Referensi TUI untuk operasi normal. 5. Gunakan Runbook ketika terjadi gangguan. Batas keamanan Jangan memasukkan .env , token, API key, raw SIEM JSON, attachment tiket, atau private key ke dokumentasi/audit publik. Jangan melewati privacy gate atau decision gate. Web Viewer dan Documentation Viewer hanya boleh bind ke 127.0.0.1 . Operasi normal wajib melalui TUI; command hanya untuk recovery darurat.

title: Gambaran Sistem
text: Gambaran Sistem Tujuan SOC Automation mempercepat intake dan triage tiket Jira, menghubungkan alert SIEM, membersihkan data sensitif, menjalankan analisis AI yang dikontrol, memperbarui Jira, mengirim Telegram, serta menjalankan Auto FP yang dibatasi policy. Komponen utama Jira sebagai sumber tiket dan workflow. Elastic/Kibana sebagai sumber alert SIEM. Python deterministic sanitizer sebagai pengendali privacy. Local AI sebagai penemu lokasi data sensitif, bukan sanitizer. Gemini sebagai analis atas JSON yang sudah aman. SQLite sebagai lease, retry, cooldown, completion, dan idempotency store. SocMaster dan worker blue/green sebagai runtime berdaya pulih. TUI sebagai control plane utama. Status Viewer dan Documentation Viewer sebagai read only visibility plane. Hasil akhir per tiket False Positive eksplisit dan aman: Jira False Incident → Done, lalu SIEM ditutup. Bukan False Positive/hasil ambigu: tiket tetap Waiting untuk analis. AI/SIEM OFF: intake selesai, tiket Waiting, Telegram terkirim, tanpa raw SIEM atau AI call.

title: Arsitektur dan Alur Kerja
text: Arsitektur dan Alur Kerja Runtime blue/green SocMaster memonitor heartbeat, PID, restart budget, backoff, startup readiness, graceful shutdown, dan active slot. Hanya worker aktif yang boleh intake. Worker standby mempertahankan readiness tetapi tidak memproses tiket. Pipeline penuh text Jira JQL → validasi project/status/assignee → persistent lease + processing state → Open → L1 Analysis → Waiting → resolve Alert ID → fetch alert SIEM → Local AI sensitive path discovery → deterministic Python sanitization → residual scan + privacy gate → sharing allowlist / Gemini → output privacy gate → Jira analysis field → decision gate ├─ FALSE POSITIVE eksplisit → False Incident → Done → SIEM close └─ lainnya/ambigu → tetap Waiting → Telegram → audit event + completion/failure state Snapshot konfigurasi Setiap tiket memakai profile, revision, hash, dan effective feature snapshot saat tiket mulai diproses. Perubahan feature di tengah proses tidak mencampur keputusan dua konfigurasi. Cutover Target standby diverifikasi, active slot diganti atomik, source menunggu drain, target menjalani stabilization, dan automatic failback dilakukan jika target tidak sehat.

title: Instalasi Automation dari Awal
text: Instalasi Automation dari Awal 1. Prasyarat host WSL/Linux 64 bit dengan user non root khusus operasi. Python sesuai requirements.txt , venv , pip , tmux , systemd user , curl , unzip , sha256sum . Akses jaringan ke Jira, SIEM, Gemini (jika aktif), Telegram (jika aktif), VirusTotal (jika aktif). Ollama/Local AI tersedia pada endpoint lokal bila Local AI digunakan. Ruang disk untuk releases, backups, audit, SQLite, dan logs. 2. Struktur direktori text ~/SOC Automation/ ├── current → releases/vX.Y.Z ├── releases/ ├── manager/ ├── shared/ │ ├── .env │ ├── audit_logs/ │ ├── logs/ │ ├── control/ │ ├── workers/ │ └── ticket_locks.sqlite3 └── .venv/ current harus berupa symlink release aktif. Data persistent berada di shared , bukan di release directory. 3. Virtual environment bash python3 m venv ~/SOC Automation/.venv ~/SOC Automation/.venv/bin/pip install r ~/SOC Automation/current/requirements.txt 4. Shared configuration Buat shared/.env dari template internal. Set permission minimum 0600 . Jangan menaruh credential di source release atau dokumentasi. 5. Service dan tmux Pasang user service untuk Manual False Incident dan Background Auto FP jika digunakan. Viewer dapat dijalankan oleh user service atau tmux sesuai TUI. 6. Preflight sebelum start pertama Jalankan Configuration Preflight, Runtime Health, Privacy Regression, Local AI Diagnostic, dan Maintenance Readiness. Semua blocker harus diperbaiki sebelum Full Automation. 7. Start pertama Gunakan TUI → Runtime Control → Start All. Pilih mode aman lebih dahulu, misalnya Manual False Incident SHADOW dan Background Auto FP SHADOW . Verifikasi master PID, active worker PID, service active, Jira connectivity, dan provider status. 8. Acceptance criteria Hanya satu active worker. SQLite integrity ok . Jira dan SIEM preflight lulus. Privacy regression lulus. Viewer hanya listen pada localhost. Tidak ada secret pada log/status endpoint.

title: Konfigurasi
text: Konfigurasi .env Kelompok konfigurasi mencakup Jira URL/account/token/workflow fields, SIEM endpoint/credential, Gemini key/model list, Local AI provider/model/endpoint, Telegram bot/chat, polling interval, worker count, timeout, dan policy feature. Nilai secret tidak boleh ditampilkan di dashboard; cukup CONFIGURED atau MISSING . Feature flags File persistent: shared/control/feature_flags.json . Penulisan menggunakan file lock, atomic replace, permission terbatas, revision, config hash, backup, dan audit append only. Configured vs effective Configured ON: operator meminta fitur aktif. Effective ON: seluruh dependency terpenuhi. Blocked: diminta ON tetapi dependency tidak tersedia. Not applicable: tidak relevan karena upstream OFF. Unavailable: konfigurasi aktif tetapi provider/service gagal. Dependency penting Gemini memerlukan SIEM retrieval dan privacy sanitization. Local AI detection memerlukan payload SIEM dan privacy pipeline. VT/sharing policy menjadi tidak relevan bila SIEM retrieval OFF. Permission .env , feature flags, ticket database, dan audit sensitif harus dapat dibaca hanya oleh user service yang berwenang.

title: Referensi Lengkap TUI
text: Referensi Lengkap TUI Dashboard Menampilkan release, versi TUI, active slot, SocMaster, worker blue/green, PID, heartbeat, SQLite, service, feature profile/revision, Local AI model/mode/reachability, serta Gemini model/mode/credential state. Dashboard read only. Gunakan ketika: memulai shift, sebelum maintenance, setelah update, atau saat incident operasi. Recovery: status UNKNOWN , DEGRADED , atau UNAVAILABLE harus ditelusuri melalui Runtime Health dan Log Viewer sebelum auto action diaktifkan. Runtime Control Pilihan: Restart Active Worker, Stop Automation, Cut Over to Standby, Deployment Status, Start All, Graceful Stop All. Restart/stop dikirim ke SocMaster. Cutover melakukan readiness, atomic active slot switch, drain, stabilization, dan failback. Start All memulai runtime dan service policy lalu memulihkan mode. Stop All menonaktifkan mode, menghentikan service, menghentikan runtime, lalu memverifikasi seluruh PID inactive. Update Manager Pilihan: Inspect Package, Verify SHA 256, Dry run Release Patch, Apply Transactional Release, Apply Manager/TUI Update, Deployment Status. Inspect memvalidasi ZIP/manifest/path/hash/minimum version. Dry run membuat validasi tanpa switch. Apply membangun staging release, memasang shared links, menjalankan checks, mengganti current atomik, dan menulis release metadata. Audit Viewer Menampilkan daftar audit, summary, full JSON, ticket audit, maintenance, feature control, Auto FP, update, dan rollback audit. Viewer membatasi path, ukuran, control sequence, key sensitif, dan truncation. Log Viewer Membaca SocMaster output, worker logs, viewer logs, Auto FP service, dan Manual False Incident service. Log bukan sumber keputusan tiket final; gunakan audit untuk outcome. Diagnostics System/Runtime Health, Configuration Preflight, Maintenance Readiness, Privacy Regression, Local AI, sanitizer diagnostic, Ticket Observability/Stuck Report, Backup Verification, Release Qualification, VT/SMB diagnostics. Viewer Services Status Viewer: Start, Stop, Status, URL pada 127.0.0.1:8765 . Documentation Viewer: Start, Stop, Status, URL, Build/Refresh pada 127.0.0.1:8766 . Semua write method ditolak. Release and Rollback Release Status, Inventory, Rollback Previous, Rollback to Version. Rollback mengganti code release dan shared link secara atomik, tetapi tidak membalik tindakan eksternal Jira/SIEM. Maintenance Cleanup Dry run/Apply, Compile Python, Retention Policy, Backup Verification, Live state Reconciliation, Ticket Reprocess/Dismiss/Restore, Sharing Allowlist, VT/SMB tools, Auto FP configuration, Manual False Incident configuration. Feature Control Center Feature & AI Dashboard, Apply Operating Profile, Configure Individual Feature, Show Effective Configuration. Perubahan atomic, revisioned, hashed, audited, dan berlaku untuk pekerjaan baru.

title: Feature dan AI Control Center
text: Feature dan AI Control Center Fitur individual jira_polling : pencarian dan intake tiket. siem_retrieval : pengambilan raw alert. privacy_sanitization : sanitasi deterministik dan privacy gate. local_ai_detection : discovery path sensitif. gemini_analysis : analisis AI cloud setelah gate. virustotal_enrichment : reputasi destination. sharing_allowlist : approved identity/domain policy. telegram_notification : notifikasi operator. status_web_viewer : status viewer. documentation_viewer : web documentation. Profile FULL_AUTOMATION Seluruh pipeline dan policy aktif. Gunakan hanya jika readiness lulus. JIRA_INTAKE_ONLY Jira polling, assignment, transition, dan Telegram aktif; SIEM, Local AI, Gemini, VT, dan sharing policy tidak dipanggil. PRIVACY_LOCAL_AI_ONLY SIEM, sanitizer, privacy gate, dan Local AI aktif; Gemini/external enrichment OFF. AI_ANALYSIS_NO_AUTO_ACTION Analisis berjalan, tindakan otomatis dibatasi; operator menjadi decision owner. MAINTENANCE_SAFE_MODE Pipeline intake/AI/auto action dinonaktifkan untuk maintenance. CUSTOM Hasil toggle individual. Wajib periksa effective reason. AI status Local AI menampilkan provider, model, endpoint, reachability, mode. Gemini menampilkan preferred model, allowed models, mode, credential configured, dan availability—tanpa API key.

title: Jira dan SIEM
text: Jira dan SIEM Intake Jira JQL mengembalikan tiket sesuai project/status. Assignee dinormalisasi ke automation account. Open melewati L1 Analysis lalu Waiting; L1 menuju Waiting; Waiting dapat langsung diproses. Alert identity Custom Alert ID adalah sumber otoritatif. Fallback terkontrol: alert link, named fields, lalu seluruh fields. Identity digunakan untuk SIEM fetch, audit binding, dan close verification. Jira result Analysis field menerima hasil yang sudah melewati output privacy. Decision gate menerima hanya prefix dan semantics yang diizinkan. Bahasa ambigu mencegah auto close. SIEM close Urutan wajib: Jira False Incident → Jira Done → verifikasi status → SIEM close dengan reason False Positive. Bila Jira gagal, SIEM tidak boleh ditutup. Partial state Jika Jira selesai tetapi SIEM close gagal, tulis partial audit/recovery state dan retry terkontrol. Jangan mengulang Jira transition secara buta.

title: Privacy, Local AI, dan Gemini
text: Privacy, Local AI, dan Gemini Local AI Local AI hanya menemukan kategori dan dot path data sensitif. Local AI tidak melakukan sanitasi dan tidak boleh menerima perintah untuk mengembalikan nilai asli. Deterministic sanitizer Python menerapkan HMAC pseudonymization, structural rules, recursive redaction, controlled propagation, certificate/private key blocking, dan residual scan. Privacy gate Gemini hanya dipanggil jika safe_for_ai=true , residual count nol, dan audit berhasil ditulis. Kegagalan mana pun menghasilkan manual review. Output privacy Keluaran AI diperiksa untuk credential, token, private key, raw identifier, dan format keputusan. Hanya output aman yang boleh menuju Jira atau Telegram. Mode OFF Gemini OFF tidak boleh dianggap error. Local AI OFF tetap mengizinkan deterministic sanitizer jika profile mengizinkan. SIEM OFF membuat privacy/AI not applicable.

title: Auto-FP dan Manual Reconciliation
text: Auto FP dan Manual Reconciliation SMB evidence Rule yang didukung adalah Rare SMB Connection to the Internet. Correlation harus terikat host, process entity, source, destination port, rule, dan time window. Scoped fan out destination dianalisis sebagai satu cluster. No observed success Eligible hanya jika tidak ada established, authentication, transfer, atau success evidence; VT cluster bersih; serta tidak ada high risk host/user atau high/critical alert blocker. Controlled Auto FP Memerlukan kill switch, project scope, eligible policy, dan rate limit per jam/hari. Dry run menghasilkan WOULD_APPLY tanpa mutasi. Background Auto FP Mode DISABLED, SHADOW, APPROVAL, LIMITED, GLOBAL. Candidate memiliki ticket/evidence binding, TTL, hash, alert UUID, dan idempotency key. Circuit breaker membatasi kegagalan berulang. Manual False Incident Scope: project CSOC, status False Incident, current user/assignee. Validasi analysis, raw audit, identity, status, lalu Jira Done dan SIEM close. Partial failure masuk recovery flow.

title: Telegram dan Viewer
text: Telegram dan Viewer Telegram Notifikasi berisi ticket key, summary aman, status, assignee, priority, jenis tiket, dan hasil aman. Intake only memakai judul khusus yang menyatakan AI/SIEM disabled. Operational alerts dideduplikasi berdasarkan fingerprint. Status Viewer Read only local dashboard untuk Workers, Feature & AI Health, Service Health, Ticket Processing, Timeline, History, dan Safety. Tidak menampilkan raw SIEM, prompt, token, atau secret. Documentation Viewer Bahasa Indonesia default, English kedua. Menyediakan sidebar, breadcrumb, full text search index, table of contents, copy button, responsive layout, print mode, version badge, dan last reviewed metadata.

title: Operasi Harian
text: Operasi Harian Startup shift 1. Buka Dashboard. 2. Periksa runtime/service/AI status. 3. Jalankan Runtime Health dan Configuration Preflight bila ada perubahan. 4. Periksa feature profile. 5. Start All jika runtime berhenti. 6. Pastikan hanya satu active worker. Shutdown maintenance 1. Tunggu in flight selesai. 2. Graceful Stop All. 3. Verifikasi service inactive dan PID hilang. 4. Buat/verifikasi backup. 5. Jalankan maintenance. Perubahan mode Gunakan TUI. Catat reason dan pastikan feature audit revision berubah. Jangan edit JSON secara manual kecuali recovery darurat.

title: Update, Backup, dan Rollback
text: Update, Backup, dan Rollback Update Preflight → readiness → backup verification → package inspect → checksum → dry run → stop jika diwajibkan → transactional staging → syntax/import/test gates → atomic current switch → start → post update verification. Backup Verifier membaca archive tanpa extraction, menghitung SHA 256, dan menolak absolute path, .. , symlink, hardlink, device, atau member berbahaya. Rollback Pilih previous atau target version. Release manager memasang shared links, menjalankan checks, dan mengganti current atomik. Restart komponen yang diminta manifest. Migration Setiap release harus mendokumentasikan minimum version, schema change, compatibility, data migration, service restart, known issues, dan rollback target.

title: Runbook Gangguan
text: Runbook Gangguan Jira unavailable Aktifkan circuit breaker behavior, jangan spam retry, periksa credential/network/rate limit, pulihkan, lalu verifikasi recovery alert. SIEM unavailable Gunakan JIRA_INTAKE_ONLY bila intake tetap dibutuhkan. Jangan menghasilkan analisis tanpa evidence. Local AI unavailable Jika policy memungkinkan, nonaktifkan Local AI dan gunakan deterministic sanitizer; jika tidak, pindah ke intake only. Gemini unavailable Nonaktifkan Gemini atau pilih privacy local only. Tiket tetap Waiting. Ticket stuck Gunakan Observability/Stuck Report, periksa lease/cooldown/failure, retest privacy bila terkait, lalu reprocess setelah root cause selesai. Viewer gagal Periksa service/tmux, bind, port, output log, restart viewer, dan hard refresh.

title: Troubleshooting
text: Troubleshooting Start All PARTIAL_OR_FAILED Periksa shared/logs/soc_master.out , PID path, active slot, import/dependency, service state, dan startup timeout. Feature ON tetapi effective OFF Lihat reason dependency. Jangan mengubah file manual; aktifkan dependency atau pilih profile yang valid. Privacy blocked Periksa residual category/path, jalankan privacy regression dan stored audit retest. Jangan bypass. Gemini credential missing Perbaiki .env melalui prosedur secret management, restart worker bila diperlukan, lalu cek status CONFIGURED. Service Health kosong Periksa endpoint JSON, content type, frontend cache, viewer version, dan browser hard refresh. Candidate expired/hash mismatch/UUID mismatch Candidate tidak boleh dieksekusi. Bangun ulang evidence dan candidate baru.

title: Keamanan dan Hardening
text: Keamanan dan Hardening Viewer bind hanya 127.0.0.1 dan menolak metode tulis. Gunakan Content Security Policy, X Frame Options, no store, dan nosniff. Secret disimpan di shared .env berpermission terbatas. Audit dan database persistent berada di shared. Package update memvalidasi path, hash, identity, dan minimum version. Jangan masukkan output command yang mengandung secret ke tiket/chat. Gunakan least privilege untuk Jira, SIEM, Telegram, Gemini, dan VT credential. Review retention policy dan backup secara berkala.

title: Pengujian dan Acceptance
text: Pengujian dan Acceptance Minimum test set Python compile/import. JavaScript syntax. ZIP integrity dan SHA 256. Release Manager dry run. TUI menu/docs parity. Bahasa Indonesia/English parity. Internal route/link check. Secret scan. Privacy regression. Jira no action dan SIEM no action test. Intake only test. Feature dependency test. Viewer read only/loopback test. Backup unsafe member test. Release gagal jika implementasi berubah tetapi dokumentasi, release notes, migration, rollback, atau version history belum diperbarui.

title: Known Issues dan Batasan
text: Known Issues dan Batasan Source TUI dalam current dapat berbeda dari manager launcher; gunakan header versi dan package metadata. Rollback code tidak membalik tindakan eksternal Jira/SIEM yang sudah selesai. Credential hanya ditampilkan sebagai CONFIGURED/MISSING. Feature changes berlaku untuk pekerjaan baru; tiket aktif memakai snapshot awal. Documentation full text search hanya mengindeks konten yang dibangun pada release aktif.

title: Riwayat Versi
text: Riwayat Versi 5.24.5–5.24.6 Perbaikan Web Viewer: fetch helper/rendering, semantic colors, cache busting, PID/service state. 5.25.0 Unified Feature & AI Control Center, profile, dependency resolver, audited flags, intake only, model/status AI. 5.25.1 Hotfix markup panel AI pada Web Viewer. 5.25.2 Workers dipindahkan ke atas; Feature & AI Health dan Service Health menjadi dropdown. 5.26.0 Fondasi dokumentasi bilingual. 5.26.1 Koreksi kelengkapan awal: referensi menu TUI, instalasi, runbook, known issues. 5.27.0 Complete Automation Operations Manual: instalasi keseluruhan automation, konfigurasi, semua control surface, pipeline, security, testing, troubleshooting, runbook, migration/rollback, serta visual dan search upgrade. Tidak mengubah pipeline produksi.

title: SOC Automation — Complete Operations Manual
text: SOC Automation — Complete Operations Manual Primary language is Indonesian; English is fully available. Documentation 5.27.0 covers the entire automation, not only the viewer: installation, configuration, TUI, Jira, SIEM, privacy, AI, Telegram, Auto FP, blue/green runtime, viewers, audit, maintenance, update, rollback, troubleshooting, tests, and history.

title: System Overview
text: System Overview SOC Automation performs Jira intake and triage, retrieves SIEM evidence, protects sensitive data, runs controlled AI analysis, updates Jira, sends Telegram notifications, and executes policy bounded Auto FP. Core components are Jira, Elastic/Kibana, deterministic Python sanitization, Local AI path discovery, Gemini analysis after privacy approval, SQLite reliability state, SocMaster blue/green supervision, TUI control, and read only viewers.

title: Architecture and Workflow
text: Architecture and Workflow SocMaster supervises blue/green workers, heartbeat, PID, restart budget, readiness, and graceful shutdown. Only the active slot performs intake. Each ticket uses a configuration snapshot. Full flow: Jira → lease → status normalization → Alert ID → SIEM → Local AI path discovery → deterministic sanitization → privacy gate → allowlist/Gemini → output privacy → Jira decision → Telegram → audit. Cutover is atomic, drain aware, stabilized, and failback capable.

title: Full Automation Installation
text: Full Automation Installation Prepare WSL/Linux, a non root service user, Python venv/pip, tmux, systemd user services, network access to configured providers, Local AI when enabled, and sufficient persistent disk. Create releases/current/manager/shared/.venv structure; keep persistent state under shared. Install requirements in the virtual environment, create shared/.env with 0600 permission, install optional user services, run configuration/health/privacy/readiness preflights, then Start All through the TUI in safe SHADOW modes. Accept only one active worker, healthy SQLite, passing privacy tests, and localhost only viewers.

title: Configuration
text: Configuration The shared .env contains Jira, SIEM, Gemini, Local AI, Telegram, polling, worker, timeout, and policy settings. Secrets are never displayed. Feature flags are stored atomically with locking, revisions, hashes, backups, permissions, and audit. Configured ON differs from Effective ON; blockers, not applicable states, and provider unavailability are shown separately. Gemini depends on SIEM retrieval and privacy sanitization.

title: Complete TUI Reference
text: Complete TUI Reference Dashboard shows runtime, services, features and AI. Runtime Control includes restart, stop, cutover, deployment status, Start All, and Graceful Stop All. Update Manager performs inspect, checksum, dry run, transactional runtime deploy, Manager/TUI update, and status. Audit/Log viewers use local path and safety restrictions. Diagnostics cover health, preflight, readiness, privacy, AI, observability, backup, qualification, and VT/SMB. Viewer Services manages ports 8765/8766. Release and Rollback restores validated releases atomically. Maintenance includes cleanup, compile, retention, backup, reconciliation, reprocess, allowlist, evidence tools, Auto FP, and Manual False Incident. Feature Control Center manages profiles, individual features, dependencies, revisions, and effective state.

title: Feature and AI Control Center
text: Feature and AI Control Center Individual features control Jira polling, SIEM retrieval, privacy sanitization, Local AI, Gemini, VirusTotal, sharing allowlist, Telegram, Status Viewer, and Documentation Viewer. Profiles: FULL_AUTOMATION, JIRA_INTAKE_ONLY, PRIVACY_LOCAL_AI_ONLY, AI_ANALYSIS_NO_AUTO_ACTION, MAINTENANCE_SAFE_MODE, and CUSTOM. Local AI shows provider/model/endpoint/reachability/mode. Gemini shows preferred and allowed models, mode, credential status, and availability without exposing keys.

title: Jira and SIEM
text: Jira and SIEM Jira intake normalizes assignee and status. The Alert ID custom field is authoritative, with controlled fallback sources. Analysis is written only after output privacy. Automatic false positive closure requires an explicit non ambiguous decision, Jira False Incident then Done, status verification, and only then SIEM close. Partial states are audited and recovered without blindly repeating Jira actions.

title: Privacy, Local AI, and Gemini
text: Privacy, Local AI, and Gemini Local AI discovers sensitive categories and paths only. Python performs HMAC pseudonymization, structural redaction, controlled propagation, restricted blob handling, and residual scanning. Gemini is called only when safe_for_ai is true and residual count is zero. AI output is checked again for secrets, identifiers, and decision format. Provider off states are supported and are not automatically errors.

title: Auto-FP and Manual Reconciliation
text: Auto FP and Manual Reconciliation SMB evidence is constrained to rule, host, process, source, destination port, and time window. No observed success requires no established/authentication/transfer/success evidence, clean VT fan out, and no high risk blockers. Controlled Auto FP uses kill switches and rate limits. Background modes are DISABLED, SHADOW, APPROVAL, LIMITED, and GLOBAL with binding, TTL, UUID/hash, idempotency, and circuit breaker. Manual reconciliation validates scope, owner, analysis, raw audit, identity, and status before action.

title: Telegram and Viewers
text: Telegram and Viewers Telegram receives privacy safe ticket metadata and results; intake only messages explicitly state that SIEM and AI were disabled. Status Viewer displays Workers, Feature and AI Health, Service Health, live processing, timeline, history, and safety without raw payloads. Documentation Viewer provides Indonesian default, English parity, navigation, full text search, table of contents, copy controls, responsive layout, print mode, version badge, and review metadata.

title: Daily Operations
text: Daily Operations Start a shift with Dashboard, health checks, feature profile review, and Start All when needed; confirm one active worker. Before maintenance, drain in flight tickets, Graceful Stop All, verify inactive state, verify backup, then maintain. Change modes only through TUI and confirm the audit revision.

title: Update, Backup, and Rollback
text: Update, Backup, and Rollback The safe workflow is preflight, readiness, verified backup, inspect, checksum, dry run, required stop, transactional staging, syntax/import/tests, atomic current switch, start, and post update verification. Backups are read without extraction and unsafe members are rejected. Rollback validates a previous release and shared links, then switches atomically. Every release documents minimum version, schema/migration, compatibility, restart, known issues, and rollback target.

title: Incident Runbooks
text: Incident Runbooks For Jira outage, allow the circuit breaker to protect intake and fix connectivity before recovery. For SIEM outage, use JIRA_INTAKE_ONLY if intake must continue. For Local AI or Gemini outage, select a safe profile instead of forcing the provider. For stuck tickets, use observability, lease/cooldown/failure review, then validated reprocess. For viewer failure, verify service/tmux, bind, port, logs, restart, and hard refresh.

title: Troubleshooting
text: Troubleshooting Start All partial failures: inspect SocMaster output, PID path, active slot, imports, service state, and timeout. Feature configured ON but effective OFF: fix dependencies. Privacy blocked: inspect residual categories and run regression/retest; never bypass. Missing Gemini credential: fix secret configuration and restart as required. Empty Service Health: verify endpoint type, cache, version, and refresh. Expired/hash/UUID mismatched candidates must be rebuilt.

title: Security and Hardening
text: Security and Hardening Bind viewers to loopback and reject write methods. Use CSP, frame denial, no store, and nosniff. Store secrets in permission restricted shared .env. Keep persistent audit/database under shared. Validate package identity, path safety, hashes, and minimum version. Use least privilege credentials and never paste secret bearing output into tickets or chats.

title: Testing and Acceptance
text: Testing and Acceptance Minimum gates: Python compile/import, JavaScript syntax, ZIP/SHA 256, release dry run, TUI/documentation parity, Indonesian/English parity, internal route/link check, secret scan, privacy regression, Jira/SIEM no action, intake only, feature dependencies, viewer read only/loopback, and malicious backup member rejection. A release fails when implementation changes but documentation, notes, migration, rollback, or history are missing.

title: Known Issues and Limitations
text: Known Issues and Limitations The current TUI source may differ from the manager launcher; use displayed version and package metadata. Code rollback does not reverse completed external Jira/SIEM actions. Credentials are shown only as CONFIGURED/MISSING. Feature changes apply to new work while active tickets retain their snapshot. Full text search indexes the active documentation build.

title: Version History
text: Version History 5.24.5–5.24.6 fixed viewer rendering, semantics, cache, and service/PID state. 5.25.0 introduced Feature and AI Control Center plus intake only; 5.25.1 fixed AI panel markup; 5.25.2 refined viewer layout. 5.26.0 established bilingual docs; 5.26.1 added initial TUI/install/runbook coverage. 5.27.0 delivers the complete automation operations manual and visual/search upgrade without changing the production pipeline.
